observations.meaning: Previously delivered messages with receipt tick, plus this actor's prior accepted/rejected/no-op dispositions. No other actor's private result or later Draft fact.
observations.missing_behavior: Empty lists on the first coordinate; malformed or non-trace-derived memory fails the run or independent publication.
